purpose: Read-only future-readiness checklist for the practice-order gate. This file does not activate the gate; the gate remains closed.

requirements.label: Operator approval recorded
requirements.notes: Operator must record explicit written approval in CLAUDE.md or a dedicated approvals registry before any practice order can be considered.

requirements.label: Kill switch tested
requirements.notes: End-to-end kill-switch dry-run required: triggering the switch must immediately halt the worker sandbox loop and re-confirm all execution flags remain false.

requirements.label: Max units defined
requirements.notes: Per-instrument maximum units (e.g. 1000 units EUR_USD) must be defined in a config registry and enforced by the Risk Sentinel.

requirements.label: Max loss defined
requirements.notes: Per-session max paper-loss threshold in pips/units must be defined and enforced.

requirements.label: Allowed instruments defined
requirements.notes: Whitelist of practice-instruments. Anything outside whitelist must be rejected even if other gates pass.

requirements.label: OANDA practice-only confirmed
requirements.notes: OANDA_ENVIRONMENT and base_url must be hard-checked to be practice. Live URL must trigger an immediate refusal.

requirements.label: Execution dry-run tests pass
requirements.notes: Dry-run tests must show that with practice_order_execution_enabled=false the dispatcher refuses to submit, and that the refusal is logged.

requirements.label: Risk Sentinel upgraded from observer to enforcer
requirements.notes: Risk Sentinel must be wired as a hard enforcement gate, not just a logging observer, with documented test coverage.

requirements.label: OpenClaw Risk Guard upgraded from observer to enforcer
requirements.notes: OpenClaw Risk Guard must enforce a hard refusal whenever any execution lock would flip; logged tests required.

requirements.label: Rollback script exists
requirements.notes: A one-shot rollback script must exist that resets every execution flag to false and stops sidecars cleanly.

requirements.label: Dashboard red warning banner works
requirements.notes: Both cockpit overlays show the red 'DANGER' banner the instant any merged lock source reports true. Verified visually in QSB_TOWER_ANIMATED_SKYSCRAPER_COCKPIT_V1.

requirements.label: Order execution remains false until checklist passes
requirements.notes: Invariant: until every blocking requirement above is satisfied AND operator gives explicit unlock, every order_*, practice_order_*, live_*, openclaw_*_execution, autonomous_dispatch_*, and direct_provider_access flag must remain false everywhere.
